name: Data Science
certifications: Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Scientist Associate (DP-100)

beginner.summary: For graduates, analysts and developers starting in data science. Covers the data science process, Python, NumPy and pandas, cleaning and exploring data, visualisation, probability, distributions, sampling, confidence intervals, hypothesis tests, regression, SQL, feature preparation, predictive models with scikit-learn, evaluation, clustering and PCA, and presenting results.
outcomes: Clean, explore and visualise data in Python
Apply probability and statistical inference correctly
Build and evaluate simple predictive and clustering models
Present results and their uncertainty clearly

days.topic: Data Science Overview and Environment Setup
subtopics: The data science lifecycle: question, data, model, communicate, act
Data science, analytics, machine learning and data engineering compared
Types of problems: description, inference, prediction and decision
Installing Python with Anaconda or uv
Version control with Git for notebooks
days.lab_task: Set up a Python environment with pinned packages, create a project repository with a standard folder layout, open a course dataset in a notebook and write the question each course project will answer.
days.deliverable: Repository with environment file, a first notebook and written project questions
checks: Recreate the environment from the file
Run the notebook from a clean kernel
Runs top to bottom without errors
Each labelled description, inference, prediction or decision

days.lab_task: Write functions that read a CSV of transactions without pandas, compute totals per customer with dictionaries, handle bad rows with exceptions and move the functions into a module.
checks: Import the module in a new notebook

days.lab_task: Simulate 100,000 dice rolls and daily returns with NumPy, compute statistics with vectorised operations and masks, and compare speed with a loop version.
Combine orders, customers and products into one table, compute revenue per segment and month, reshape it to wide form and write the steps as one method chain.
checks: Row count explained after each join
Compare a total with a manual calculation

days.topic: Cleaning Data and Handling Missing Values
subtopics: Missing completely at random, at random and not at random
days.lab_task: Clean a messy patient visits dataset: fix types and dates, study missingness patterns, choose a strategy per column with reasons, remove duplicates and log every change.
Explore a housing dataset with summaries, plots and group comparisons, list five data problems and five hypotheses, and mark which findings need testing before they are trusted.
checks: Problems missed by the profile noted
objectives: Avoid reading too much into patterns

days.topic: Data Visualisation for Exploration and Explanation
days.lab_task: Make six exploratory plots of the housing data, then turn the two most important into explanatory charts with finding titles and annotations.
days.deliverable: Notebook with exploratory and explanatory charts

days.lab_task: Solve five probability problems including a medical test with Bayes' theorem, check each answer by simulation and explain the base rate fallacy in plain words.
days.deliverable: Notebook with calculations, simulations and explanation
checks: Correct probability of disease given a positive test

subtopics: Discrete distributions: Bernoulli, binomial and Poisson
Continuous distributions: uniform, normal and exponential
Choosing a distribution for a problem
days.lab_task: Model call arrivals with Poisson, waiting times with exponential and heights with normal distributions, fit them to data, check fit with Q-Q plots and answer three business questions.
days.deliverable: Notebook with fits, plots and answers
checks: Answer "probability of more than 10 calls in an hour"
Correct value from the fitted model

days.topic: Sampling and the Central Limit Theorem
days.lab_task: Simulate sampling from a skewed population, show the sampling distribution of the mean becoming normal, estimate standard errors by formula and by bootstrap, and show how sample size changes precision.
checks: Double the sample size four times

days.lab_task: Estimate average order value and conversion rate with intervals by formula and bootstrap, compute the interval for the difference between two channels and report results with correct wording.
days.deliverable: Notebook and a short written report
checks: Interval for the channel difference reported

subtopics: Type I and type II errors
days.lab_task: Test whether a new website layout changed conversion and time on page, choose suitable tests, report p-values with effect sizes and calculate the power the study had.
checks: Effect size with interval for each test

days.lab_task: Model house price from size with linear regression, interpret the coefficients, check residuals and explain why the slope does not prove that size causes price.
checks: Pattern described and a fix suggested

days.lab_task: Build a customer feature table in SQL with joins and window functions, read it into pandas with a parameterised query and compare speed with doing the same work in pandas.
days.deliverable: SQL queries, notebook and timing comparison
checks: Faster in the database for the large table

subtopics: Text length and simple text features
days.lab_task: Prepare features for predicting late deliveries: encode categories, extract date parts, scale numbers and show how fitting the scaler on all data leaks information.
checks: Fit preparation on training data only
Test data transformed with training parameters
Leaky score higher than the honest score
Each feature available at prediction time

days.lab_task: Predict late deliveries with a baseline, logistic regression, k-nearest neighbours and a decision tree inside pipelines, and compare them on the same split.
checks: All scored on the same test set
Preparation and model in one pipeline

subtopics: Regression metrics: MAE, RMSE and R-squared
Classification metrics: accuracy, precision, recall and F1
Choosing a metric for the business problem
days.lab_task: Evaluate the delivery models with cross-validation, plot confusion matrices and curves, diagnose overfitting with learning curves and choose a metric that fits the cost of missed late deliveries.
days.deliverable: Evaluation notebook and metric choice note
checks: Mean and spread of scores reported
Overfitting shown by the learning curve

days.lab_task: Reduce a customer behaviour dataset with PCA, cluster customers with k-means and hierarchical clustering, compare results and describe each cluster in business terms.
checks: Each described with its key numbers

days.lab_task: Turn the delivery model notebook into a Quarto report and a five-minute presentation for operations managers, including uncertainty, limits and a recommendation.
checks: Render the report from the notebook

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: End-to-End Data Science Project
days.lab_task: Answer a question from a public dataset end to end: frame it, clean and explore the data, test one hypothesis, build and evaluate a model against a baseline and present a reproducible report.
objectives: Combine the beginner topics in one project
Answer a real question with data

intermediate.summary: For working data scientists and analysts moving into modelling. Covers multiple regression and GLMs, regularisation, tree-based models, model selection, experiment design, Bayesian analysis, forecasting, survival analysis, text data, recommendations, anomaly detection, imbalanced data, interpretation, reproducible workflows, PySpark, neural networks, serving models, problem framing and responsible data science.
prerequisites: Uses pandas and scikit-learn for modelling
Understands hypothesis tests, confidence intervals and regression
Has completed at least one modelling project
outcomes: Choose and fit suitable statistical and machine learning models
Design experiments and use Bayesian methods
Model time, survival, text and behaviour data
Deliver reproducible, explainable and responsible data science work

days.topic: Multiple Regression and Generalised Linear Models
subtopics: Interpreting odds ratios and rate ratios
days.lab_task: Model insurance claim counts with Poisson and negative binomial regression, check for overdispersion, interpret rate ratios for key factors and compare models with AIC.

days.topic: Regularisation: Ridge, Lasso and Elastic Net
days.lab_task: Predict house prices with 200 features using ridge, lasso and elastic net, tune penalties with cross-validation and check how stable lasso's selected features are across bootstrap samples.
days.deliverable: Notebook, tuning results and stability chart

days.lab_task: Predict loan default with a random forest and LightGBM, use early stopping, compare with regularised logistic regression and compare split importance with permutation importance.
checks: Best iteration chosen on validation data
Scores compared on the same test set

days.topic: Model Selection, Tuning and Validation Strategy
days.lab_task: Tune a model on patient data with repeated visits using grouped cross-validation, compare with naive cross-validation, tune with Optuna and record all runs in MLflow.
checks: Score on the held-out test once

days.lab_task: Design an experiment testing two factors in a pricing page with a factorial design, calculate the sample size, pre-register the analysis and analyse simulated results with regression.
days.deliverable: Experiment design, power calculation and analysis
checks: Size for the target effect and power
Metrics and tests fixed before data

days.lab_task: Analyse an A/B test with a Bayesian model in PyMC, check convergence and the posterior predictive, report the probability that B beats A and test sensitivity to the prior.
checks: R-hat near 1 and enough effective samples

days.topic: Forecasting with ARIMA, ETS and Gradient Boosting
subtopics: Lag features for machine learning forecasts
days.lab_task: Forecast hourly electricity demand with seasonal ARIMA, ETS and a LightGBM model with lag features, backtest each with rolling origins and compare accuracy and intervals.
checks: Error per method for each origin

subtopics: Customer churn as a survival problem
days.lab_task: Model time to churn for subscribers, plot Kaplan-Meier curves by plan, compare plans with a log-rank test, fit a Cox model and check its assumptions.
checks: Curves by plan with censoring marks

days.lab_task: Classify customer reviews with TF-IDF and logistic regression and with sentence embeddings, find topics with BERTopic and compare LLM labels with 200 human labels.
checks: Scores on the same test set
Topics labelled and checked against examples

subtopics: Offline evaluation: precision at k and recall at k
days.lab_task: Build product recommendations from purchase history with a popularity baseline, item similarity and matrix factorisation, evaluate with precision at 10 and handle new users.
Detect unusual transactions with a z-score rule, isolation forest and local outlier factor, compare the top 50 alerts from each and review them against a small set of known fraud cases.
checks: Each top alert explained or dismissed

subtopics: Resampling: under and over sampling and SMOTE
days.lab_task: Predict rare equipment failures, compare class weights and SMOTE, calibrate probabilities and choose a threshold that maximises expected savings from a cost matrix.
days.deliverable: Notebook, calibration plot and threshold analysis
checks: Calibration curve closer to the diagonal

days.lab_task: Explain the loan default model globally and for three individual decisions with SHAP and partial dependence, check the explanations against domain knowledge and write a customer-facing explanation.
Turn the churn project into a pipeline with versioned data, configuration files and tests, run it in CI and have a partner reproduce the model and metrics.

subtopics: When data does not fit in memory
days.lab_task: Build customer features from 500 million events with PySpark, train an MLlib model, compare with a sampled pandas workflow and explain when each approach is right.
checks: Feature table created for all customers

days.topic: Neural Networks with PyTorch for Tabular, Text and Images
subtopics: When neural networks beat tree models
days.lab_task: Train a small network on tabular data with embeddings and compare it with LightGBM, then fine-tune a pretrained image model to classify product photos.
checks: Scores on the same test set
Training stops when validation loss rises

days.topic: Packaging and Serving Models as APIs
days.lab_task: Package the churn pipeline, serve it with FastAPI with input validation, run it in Docker, add a batch scoring script and log predictions for monitoring.
days.deliverable: API code, Dockerfile, batch script and prediction log

subtopics: From business problem to data science problem
days.lab_task: Interview a role-play operations director, turn a vague request into a framed problem with the decision, metric, baseline and data, run a feasibility check and agree a scoped plan.
days.deliverable: Problem framing document and scoped plan

subtopics: Transparency and documentation: model cards and datasheets
Regulation: GDPR, DPDP and the EU AI Act
days.lab_task: Audit the loan model for fairness across groups, try one mitigation and its trade-off, write a model card and datasheet and complete a risk review.
days.deliverable: Fairness audit, model card, datasheet and risk review
checks: Trade-off between fairness and accuracy reported

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Customer Lifetime and Retention Modelling
days.lab_task: For a subscription business, frame the retention problem, model time to churn with survival analysis, predict churn risk with a tuned model, explain and audit it, serve it as an API in a reproducible pipeline and present a retention plan.
days.deliverable: Pipeline repository, API, model card and presentation
checks: Same metrics from a clean run
Risk score and top drivers returned
Actions linked to model evidence and costs
objectives: Combine the intermediate topics in one project

advanced.summary: For senior and lead data scientists. Covers causal machine learning, hierarchical Bayesian models, adaptive experiments and bandits, optimisation, simulation, LLMs in data science, graph and spatial data, observational data correction, MLOps for data scientists, scaling with Spark and Ray, system design, model risk, privacy-preserving analysis, global forecasting models, research methods, business value, failing models and leading data science teams.
prerequisites: Several years of modelling experience in production or research
Confident with statistics, Bayesian methods and machine learning
Has delivered models used for real decisions
outcomes: Estimate causal effects and run adaptive experiments
Build decision models with optimisation, simulation and Bayesian methods
Run data science reliably at scale under model risk rules
Lead data science work that creates measured business value

days.topic: Causal Machine Learning: Double ML and Heterogeneous Effects
subtopics: Meta-learners: S, T and X learners
days.lab_task: Estimate the effect of a discount on purchases from observational data with double machine learning, estimate effects per customer with a causal forest, run refutation tests and design a targeting policy.
days.deliverable: Causal notebook, refutation results and targeting policy
checks: Estimate stable under placebo and subset tests
Expected gain compared with treating everyone

days.lab_task: Model conversion rates for 300 stores with a hierarchical model, fix divergences with a non-centred version, compare pooling choices with LOO and explain shrinkage for small stores.
days.deliverable: Model notebook and explanation of shrinkage
checks: Small-store estimates move toward the mean and the reason is given

days.lab_task: Simulate headline testing with fixed A/B allocation, Thompson sampling and a contextual bandit, compare regret and evaluate a new policy offline from logged data.
checks: Estimated value of the new policy with an interval
Cases for bandits and for fixed tests

days.topic: Optimisation and Operations Research for Data Scientists
days.lab_task: Allocate a marketing budget and a delivery fleet using demand forecasts with linear and integer programming, add business constraints and test how the solution changes when inputs shift.
days.deliverable: Optimisation models, solutions and sensitivity analysis
checks: Main drivers of the decision explained

days.topic: Simulation and Monte Carlo Methods for Decisions
days.lab_task: Simulate a call centre with SimPy to choose staffing levels, validate against historical wait times, compare three staffing plans and report the probability of breaching the service level.
days.deliverable: Simulation code, validation and staffing recommendation
checks: Simulated waits match history within tolerance

days.topic: Large Language Models in Data Science Work
days.lab_task: Extract structured fields from 2,000 support emails with an LLM, evaluate against human labels, use embeddings as features in a classifier and compare cost and accuracy with a fine-tuned small model.
days.deliverable: Extraction pipeline, evaluation and cost comparison
checks: Personal data removed before API calls

days.lab_task: Build a graph of accounts sharing devices and addresses, find communities and central accounts, add graph features to a fraud model and measure the improvement.
Model house prices with location, test for spatial autocorrelation in residuals, add spatial features, validate with spatial cross-validation and map the errors.

days.topic: Observational and Survey Data: Weighting and Bias Correction
days.lab_task: Correct a biased online survey to match census totals with raking and MRP, handle missing answers with multiple imputation and compare adjusted and raw estimates.

days.topic: MLOps for Data Scientists: From Notebook to Production
days.lab_task: Move the churn model into a training pipeline with tracking, a registry, a validation gate and drift monitoring, then define a retraining policy with the engineering team.
days.deliverable: Pipeline, registry entries, monitoring report and retraining policy

days.topic: Scaling Data Science with Spark and Ray
subtopics: Ray for parallel training and tuning
days.lab_task: Train 1,000 store-level forecast models in parallel with Ray, tune hyperparameters with Ray Tune, compare run time and cost with a single machine and debug a failing task.
days.deliverable: Distributed code, timings and cost comparison

days.lab_task: Write a design document for a real-time pricing system: requirements, data flows, model choices, serving, feedback, fallbacks and monitoring, and defend it in a design review.

subtopics: SR 11-7 and RBI model risk guidance
days.lab_task: Independently validate a credit scoring model: review its design, re-run its results, build a benchmark model, back-test it and write a validation report with findings and ratings.
checks: Each finding rated with an action

days.lab_task: Publish statistics from a patient dataset with differential privacy at three budgets, generate synthetic data, measure its usefulness for a model and its re-identification risk.
days.deliverable: Private statistics, synthetic data and evaluation
checks: Error rises as the budget falls

days.topic: Demand Forecasting at Scale with Global Models
days.lab_task: Forecast demand for 5,000 products with a global LightGBM model and per-series baselines, produce quantile forecasts, reconcile to category totals and feed the quantiles into a stock policy.
days.deliverable: Forecasting pipeline, evaluation and stock policy results
checks: Service level and stock cost reported

days.topic: Research Methods and Reading the Literature
days.lab_task: Pick a recent method relevant to the team, reproduce its main result on a public dataset, test it on company-like data and write a technical report recommending whether to adopt it.
checks: Close to the published number or gaps explained
Performance compared with the current method

subtopics: From model metrics to business metrics
Cost of building and running models
Stopping projects that do not pay
days.lab_task: Estimate the business value of three existing models using holdout results and costs, rank them and recommend which to expand, keep or retire.
checks: Value per model in money terms
Expand, keep or retire for each with reasons

days.topic: Diagnosing Failing Models and Data Problems
days.lab_task: Investigate four failing models (a changed upstream field, delayed labels, concept drift and a segment failure), find each root cause, fix it and write a post-incident review.
days.deliverable: Investigation notes, fixes and a post-incident review
checks: Changed field and its effect identified

days.topic: Leading Data Science Teams and Strategy
days.lab_task: Write a 12-month data science strategy for a company: team model, hiring plan, prioritised roadmap, standards and how value will be measured, and present it to a role-play executive team.
checks: Projects ranked with value and feasibility
Roles and levels justified by the roadmap

days.lab_task: For a case retailer, design and deliver a promotion decision system: estimate promotion effects causally, forecast demand probabilistically, optimise promotion choices under budget, validate the models independently, put them into a monitored pipeline and present measured value to a leadership panel.
days.deliverable: Design document, models, validation report, pipeline and leadership presentation
checks: Value of the system measured against the current process
objectives: Combine the advanced topics in one programme
